title: Past perfect continuous (I had been doing)

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions of the situations and make sentences using the words in brackets.

items.cue: 😩 Tom was exhausted when he got home.
answers: He’d been working hard all day.
He had been working hard all day.

items.cue: ⚽ The children came into the house with a ball. They were both worn out.
🧳 I was disappointed when I had to cancel my holiday.
answers: I’d been looking forward to it.
I had been looking forward to it.

items.cue: 🌙 Anna woke up in the middle of the night, frightened and confused.
answers: She’d been having a bad dream.
She had been having a bad dream.

items.cue: 📺 When I got home, Mark was sitting in front of the TV. He had just turned it off.
answers: He had been watching a film.

items.cue: 🚏 The people at the bus stop were getting impatient. The bus was very late.
answers: They’d been waiting a long time.
They had been waiting a long time.

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions of the situations and complete the sentences.

items.cue: 🎾 We played tennis yesterday, but we didn’t finish the game.
🍽️ I’d arranged to meet Tom in a restaurant. I got there and waited for him.
🏢 Sarah worked for a company for a long time. The company doesn’t exist any more.
🎻 I went to a concert. Soon after the orchestra began playing, something strange happened.
parts: (play) for about ten minutes when a man in the audience suddenly

items.cue: ✍️ Your own sentence. The key has one version: you’d walked for about ten minutes, and then a car suddenly stopped just behind you.
parts: I began walking along the road. I
answers: I’d been walking for about ten minutes
a car suddenly stopped just behind me

items.cue: 🎉 It was noisy next door last night.
options: Our neighbours were having a party.
Our neighbours had been having a party.

items.cue: 😴 At the end of our journey we were extremely tired.
options: We were travelling for more than 24 hours.
We’d been travelling for more than 24 hours.

items.cue: 🔍 James was on his hands and knees on the floor.
options: He was looking for his contact lens.
He’d been looking for his contact lens.

items.cue: 😮‍💨 Sue was sitting on the ground, out of breath.
options: She was running.
She’d been running.

items.cue: 🚶 John and I went for a walk.
options: He was walking very fast and I had difficulty keeping up with him.
He’d been walking very fast and I had difficulty keeping up with him.

items.cue: 🚗 I was sad when I sold my car.
options: I’ve had it for a very long time.
I’d had it for a very long time.

items.cue: ☕ I was sad when my local café closed.
options: I was going there for many years.
I’d been going there for many years.

items.cue: 🏃 I’m running a marathon next month.
options: I’ve been training for it every day.
I’d been training for it every day.

items.cue: ⏰ I’d arranged to meet Kate, but I was late. When I finally arrived, …
options: she was waiting for me. She was annoyed because she was waiting such a long time
she was waiting for me. She was annoyed because she’d been waiting such a long time
she’d been waiting for me. She was annoyed because she was waiting such a long time
she’d been waiting for me. She was annoyed because she’d been waiting such a long time

items.cue: 🏢 Joe and I work for the same company, and he joined it before me. When I started a few years ago, …
options: he was already working there.
he’d already been working there.

items.cue: 🏢 I started at the company a few years ago. At the time I started, …
options: Joe was already working there for two years.
Joe had already been working there for two years.

items.cue: 🏢 Joe still works for the company.
options: He’s been working there a long time now.
He’d been working there a long time now.
